tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// 'phags pa mig rnam par sbyong ba/ mig nad rab tu zhi ba/ kṣa ya'i nad rab tu zhi ba/ gzhang 'brum zhi ba/ nad thams cad zhi ba/ rims nad zhi ba/ rma bya'i snying po bcas bzhugs so//

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ārya tsakṣu bi sho dha na nā ma bidya/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa mig rnam par sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i rig sngags/ sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das shākya'i grong rdal bzang po zhig na/ shākya rnams kyi nang na bzhugs te de'i tshe sta du sa zhes bya ba na/ shākya bde ba zhes bya ba sangs rgyas la mngon par dad pa dang*/ chos dang dge 'dun la mngon par dad pa dang*/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song*/ chos la skyabs su song*/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song*/ sangs rgyas la gcig tu phyogs/ chos la gcig tu phyogs/ dge 'dun la gcig tu phyogs/ sangs rgyas la nem nur med cing the tshom med/ chos dang dge 'dun dang*/ sdug bsngal dang*/ kun 'byung ba dang*/ 'gog pa dang*/ lam la nem nur med cing the tshom med la/ bden pa'i 'bras bu thob pa/ mngon par rdzogs par gyur pa/ mtshon dang dbyig pa bor ba zhig gnas pa de'i mig la snang ba dang*/ mi snang ba'i gzugs rnams snang bar gyur nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la dad pa skyes te/ yid la byed cing*/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das snang ba mdzad pa/ sgron ma 'dzin pa/ gsal ba 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo// bde bar gshegs pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa gsal bar mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi mig rnam par sbyang du gsol/ zhes bya ba dang*/ bcom ldan 'das lha'i gnas pa la bzhugs pa/ lha'i snyan rnam par dag pa/ mi las 'das pas/ shākya bde bas tshig de skad ces brjod pa gsan to// gsan nas kyang ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs te/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod song la mig rnam par sbyong ba'i rig sngags 'dis/ shākya bde ba la srungs bar gyis shig yongs su bzung ba dang yongs su bskyang ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/

bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa spang ba dang*/ mtshon cha spang ba dang*/ dug gzhil ba dang*/ dug bsad pa dang*/ mtshams bcad pa dang*/ sa bcing bar gyis shig dang*/ de bzhin du 'khor bzhi po dge slong rnams dang*/ dge slong ma rnams dang*/ dge bsnyen rnams dang*/ dge bsnyen ma rnams dang*/ sems can gzhan gyi mig kyang rnam par sbyongs shig /mig sbubs rnam par sbyongs shig /tadya thā/ hi li mi li/ ki li mi li/ hi li te/ hu yā hu yā hu yā/ ma ni/ hu lu hu lu hu lu/ hu du hu du hu du/ tsakṣur mu kha bi sho dha ya swā hā/ kun dga' bo rig sngags kyi rgyal po mig rnam par sbyong ba 'di ni/ mig gi skyon dang*/ rlung gi skyon dang*/ mkhris pa'i skyon dang*/ bad kan gyi skyon dang*/ 'dus pa las gyur pa'i skyon bsal te/ tshul khrims kyi bden pa dang*/ brtul zhugs kyi bden pa dang*/ drang srong rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i bden pa dang*/ sdug bsngal gyi bden pa dang*/ kun 'byung ba'i bden pa dang*/ 'gog pa'i bden pa dang*/ lam gyi bden pa dang*/ dgra bcom pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bden pas/ shākya bde ba'i mig na bar ma gyur cig /mchi ma 'dzag par ma gyur cig /kun du mchi ma 'dzag par ma gyur cig /bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi mig rnam par dag par gyur cig /kun dga' bo rig sngags kyi rgyal mo mig rnam par sbyong ba 'di ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas drug gis gsungs pa'o// nga yang de ltar 'chad de/ rgyal po bzhi dang*/ lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin dang*/ mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pa yang rjes su yi rang ngo*// kun dga' bo rig sngags 'di dus gsum du brjod na/ de la 'thibs por 'gyur ba dang*/ rab rib bam/ ling tog gam/ mig nad sngon por mthong ba'am/ mig gi yul gyi skyon lha las gyur pa rnams sam/

klu las gyur pa rnams sam/ dri za las gyur pa rnams sam/ gnod sbyin las gyur pa rnams sam/ sha za las gyur pa rnams sam/ byad las gyur pa rnams sam/ ro langs las gyur pa rnams sam/ ro langs dang byad las gyur pa rnams sam/ kun du rgyu las gyur pa rnams sam/ kun du rgyu dang ro langs las gyur pa rnams kyis tshugs par 'gyur ba ni/ lha dang bcas pa dang*/ bdud dang bcas pa dang*/ tshangs pa dang bcas pa dang*/ dge sbyong dang bram zer bcas pa dang*/ lha dang*/ mi dang*/ lha ma yin bcas pa'i skye dgu'i 'jig rten na ngas ma mthong ste/ de ni gnas med do// tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das kyi ltar nyan te/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin no zhes gsol nas/ gsang sngags kyi gzhi rnams bzung ste/ kun chub par byas nas shākya bde ba ga la bar der song ste/ bde ba mig rnam par sbyong ba'i gsang sngags kyi gzhi dag de bzhin gshegs pas khyod la bskur gyis nyin re bzhin dus gsum du dran par gyis shig /ces de la rgyas par smras so// shākya bde bas thos ma thag tu de kho nar mig rnam par dag ste/ mig rnam par dag pas dri ma med pa'i mig gis thams cad mthong ngo*// bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang*/ shākya bde ba dang*/ lha dang bcas pa 'i 'jig rten yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/// /'phags pa mig rnam par sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i rig sngags rdzogs so/// / ༈ 'phags pa mig nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i mdo bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ ārya akṣi ro ga pra sha ma ṇi sū tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa mig nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na/ bya rgod phung po'i ri la bzhugs te/ de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po nag po/

bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer chen po 'dir/ mig nad byung na de dag la ji ltar bsgrub par bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ nag po mig nad kyi sngags kyi tshig 'di dag yod de/ tadya thā/ ru dhi re phu ra dhi ra/ akṣi pu/ ru dha ri pi ga le phu/ bha te phu: ba delephu: ha na te phu: maṃ sa du dhu bhi phu/ padma akṣi phu/ padma daṇḍa hi ra ṇi ye phu:/ swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' bstsal nas/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po nag po yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// cho ga ni 'di yin te/ srad bu dkar po la lan bdun bzlas pa byas te/ mdud pa bdun bor ro// chu la lan bdun bzlas pa byas la lag pas byabs na/ mig nad zhi bar 'gyur ro// 'phags pa mig nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i mdo rdzogs so/// /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// kṣa ya'i nad sel ba'i sngags/ na mo hi tu he ke swā hā/ lus la nad byung na/ nad khong skems kyis btab na/ bsil yab chus gtor te/ lan drug bcu rtsa gcig bsngags nas/ de'i lus la g.yabs na nad med par 'gyur ro// kṣa ya'i nad sel ba'i gzungs rdzogs so/// / ༈ rgya gar skad du/ ārya ārsha pra sha ma ni sū tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa gzhang 'brum rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i mdo// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na 'od ma'i tshal bya ka lan da ka gnas pa'i tshal na/ dge slong lnga brgya tsam gyi dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na bco lnga'i gso sbyong zla ba nya ba de nyid kyi tshe/ dge 'dun gyi mdun na gdan bshams pa la bzhugs so// de'i tshe tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo bcom ldan 'das kyi gnam logs na rnga yab thogs te/

bcom ldan 'das la g.yob cing 'dug par gyur to// de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab 'di na/ dge slong gzhang 'brum can mang po dag /gzhang 'brum gyi bro nad kyis gzir te/ sdug bsngal mi bzad pa drag po mi bde ba/ yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshor ba myong bar gyur na/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das de dag la bdag gis ji ltar bsgrub par bgyi/ de skad ces gsol pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces bka' bstsal to// kun dga' bo khyod kyis gzhang 'brum sel ba'i mdo 'di longs shig /kun dga' bo gang la la zhig gis/ gzhang 'brum sel ba'i mdo'i ming dang*/ tshig dang*/ yi ge shes nas/ de ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar du gzhang 'brum gyi nad kyis btab par mi 'gyur ro// tshe rabs bdun gyi bar du tshe rabs dran par 'gyur ro// tadya thā/ a laṇṭe/ a ma le shwa li tsi ni/ ku she saṃ bhe swā hā/ kun dga' bo 'di lta ste/ byang phyogs na ri'i rgyal po gangs zhes bya ba de na/ sā la'i shing rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba de'i me tog gsum yod do// gcig ni 'phel ba zhes bya/ gnyis pa ni 'jam pa zhes bya/ gsum pa ni skam po zhes bya ste/ ji ltar de bskams pa de bzhin du/ sems can rnams kyi rlung gi 'brum bu bskam par gyur cig /mkhris pa'i 'brum bu bskam par gyur cig /bad kan gyi 'brum bu bskam par gyur cig /mi gtsang ba'i 'brum bu bskam par gyur cig /khrag gi 'brum bu bskam par gyur cig /'dus pa'i 'brum bu bskam par gyur cig /de bzhin du bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi bad kan gyi 'brum bu bskam par gyur cig /mi gtsang ba'i 'brum bu bskam par gyur cig

/khrag gi 'brum bu bskam par gyur cig /'dus pa'i 'brum bu bskam par gyur cig /sna'i 'brum bu bskam par gyur cig /'phyang ba'i 'brum bu bskam par gyur cig /tadya thā/ sha me sha me ne/ sha ma sha mā ne swā hā/ na bar ma gyur cig /rengs par ma gyur cig /sgra 'byung bar ma gyur cig /'dzag par ma gyur cig /sdug bsngal bar ma gyur cig /rab tu sdug bsngal bar ma gyur cig /zag par ma gyur cig rab tu zag par ma gyur cig /'di nyid du zad pa dang*/ yongs su zad pa dang*/ med par gyur cig /'og tu song zhig /na mo bha ga ba te/ buddha ya/ sa tya/ bā dī nī/ siddha yantu/ mant+ra/ pa dā ni swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' bstsal nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// de la cho ga ni 'di yin te/ bklags pas 'grub pa 'di srad bu dmar po la lan bdun bzlas pa byas la/ mdud pa bdun bor te mgul du gdags so// 'phags pa gzhang 'brum rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i mdo rdzogs so/// /rgya gar skad gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang*/ dā na shi la dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo tstsha ba ban dhe ye shes sdes bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'o// ༈ rgya gar skad du/ ārya sarba ro ga pra sha ni nā ma dha ra ni/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag chos kyi rnam grangs 'di zungs shig /chongs shig /lhogs shig /kun chub par gyis shig /gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par ston cig /tadya thā/ tsa le me/ tsa le me/ paṃ na ko ki li/

shri me ti/ kunḍa le/ dundu bhe/ ind+ra ni/ mu khe swā hā/ 'di dag ni zas ma bzhu ba dang*/ sbos pa dang*/ khrag dang*/ mkhris pa 'dris pa dang*/ gzhang 'brum gyis btab pa dang*/ gzhang nad can dang*/ za gu dang*/ lung pa can dang*/ rims nad can dang*/ klad pa na ba dang*/ gzhogs phyed na ba dang*/ yi dwags kyis zin pa'i gsang sngags kyi gzhi yin te/ kun dga' bo gang gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag las 'gal bar byed pa de ni/ ngas lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na ma mthong ngo*// tshe zad pa ni ma gtogs so// gsang sngags gyi gzhi 'di dag ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa ste/ 'di la sangs rgyas ni sems can thams cad kyi mchog go /'dod chags dang bral ba ni chos thams cad kyi mchog go /dge 'dun ni tshogs thams cad kyi mchog go /bden pa'i tshig dang*/ bden pa'i ngag 'di bdag gis zos pa dang*/ 'thung ba dang*/ 'chos pa dang*/ myangs pa rnams legs par bde bar zhu bar gyur cig swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' bstsal nas/ dge slong de dag yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// 'phags pa nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs rdzogs so/// / ༈ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// tadya thā/ i li mi ti me le/ ha ne su ha ne/ che ge mo zhig dza ra bandha me/ e ka hi ka na/ tri hi kaṃ tsa tu rtsa ka na/ sni tya dzwa rā na swā hā/ cho ga ni 'di bris te mgul du btags na rims nad med par byed do// rims nad zhi ba'i gzungs rdzogs so/// / ༈ rgya gar skad du/ ārya dzwa ra pra sha ma ni nā ma dhā ra ṇi/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa rims nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad dag gis thos pa dus gcig na/

bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal na bzhugs so// de nas dge slong zhig bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ phyogs gcig tu 'dug go /phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas dge slong des bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// btsun pa bcom ldan 'das 'di na sems can rnams rims nad kyis gtses par mchis na/ bcom ldan 'das de dag bsrung du gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo phyogs 'di na me lce'i 'phreng ba zhes bya ba'i rims nad 'dug ste/ sems can rnams la nyin gcig pa dang*/ nyin gnyis pa dang*/ nyin gsum pa dang*/ nyin bzhi pa la sogs pa la thugs rje dang ldan pas brtse bar byed pas de srung ba'i gsang sngags kyi gzhi rnams 'di dag yin no// tadya thā/ dzwa la ni dzwa la ni/ pra ti ba ni pra sha ma ni bdag gi rims nad song zhig /ma 'dug cig swā hā/ bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig dang*/ 'jig rten na sangs rgyas dang*/ chos dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gis bdag gi rims nad song zhig /ma 'dug cig swā hā/ sid dhaṃ tu mant+ra pa tā ba dha bi dya na pra ma a nu mo do swā hā/ skud pa nag po la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas shing mdud pa nyi shu rtsa gcig bor ro// bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' bstsal nas/ dge slong de dag yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// 'phags pa rims nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs rdzogs so/// /

༈ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas kun nas thogs med ston la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ pi shu ne swā hā/ 'di bzung bas 'phags pa rma bya chen mo gzung bar 'gyur ro// 'phags pa rma bya chen mo'i snying po rdzogs so/// / ༈ rgya gar skad du/ ārya bighnan bi nā ya kā ra tra dhā ra ṇi/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa bgegs sel ba'i gzungs/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa'i dze ta'i tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs te/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo tshogs kyi bdag po'i snying po 'dzin pa des mchog thams cad dang*/ dgongs pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro// gsung sngags thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro// tadya thā/ na mastu te/ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ da ra da ra/ ḍa ha ḍa ha/ gri hna/ bhañdza bhañdza/ na mastu te/ ru ru tsa tsa ye swā hā/ a bhu trā bi na duḥ khaṃ mañtse ddha ba ra sa gatstsha ti ha ha ya/ ma hā hastitk+ṣa ta na na/ pra go ba ye mo/ ku ru ku ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ na mo na maḥswā hā/ nangs par langs te sngags lan bdun bzlas la/ chu khyor ba gang steng dang 'og gi phyogs su gtor cig dang*/ gegs thams cad bcings par 'gyur/ gsang sngags sgrub par 'dod pas skud pa dkar po la mdud pa nyi shu rtsa gcig bor te lag pa la bcings na rig sngags 'grub par 'gyur ro// gegs thams cad bcings par 'gyur ro// gang na tshogs kyi bdag po snang ba der gzungs 'di lan gcig bklags na yang gegs rnams bar chad mi byed do// bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' bstsal nas 'khor de dag thams cad dga' ste/ lha dang mi dang*/ lha ma yin dang dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// 'phags pa gegs sel ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so/// /gu gul ser po dang pha waṃ gi rtug pa kun la bsku ba'i rtug pa sbyar ba'i du bas bdugs na 'go ba'i nad pa'i gam du phyin yang mi tshugs/
gos pa la thug na myur du sel/ khyim du 'byung pos gnod pa dag la rab tu bsngags so/// /
